class.jaymoskingdoms.option.calling_back: Within a minute of a final fall, say the rite over the fallen and a pinch of diamond dust brings them back before the dark: weak, sick and half their strength gone, but whole. It is not one of their two wakings. A cleric of the settlements will do it unasked for a diamond from the fallen's own pocket, and then rests three days. A death with no body left to call (beheaded, the void, lava) cannot be called back.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.keeping.desc: A rite, spoken slowly over the dead: every body within a few blocks is kept fresh for ten days. It does not rot and does not get up, and no necromancer can raise it. The cleric of a settlement does the same for the dead near them.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.rebirth.desc: In a grove, over the body of one who is dead for good and waiting in Limbo (within ten days), the rite gives them another body in a new, random blood. They keep their name and memories and what they carried. The old body's gifts are gone. An old druid in a forest grove does it for any body laid at their feet.
message.jaymoskingdoms.keeping.wrapped: You bind the body in salt and herbs.
message.jaymoskingdoms.grave.no_ground: There is no firm ground here to lay a body in.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rebirth.no_grove: This is no grove. The rite wants old wood round it: trunks, and a roof of leaves.
message.jaymoskingdoms.rebirth.new_blood: You are born again, in the blood of the %s.
message.jaymoskingdoms.slime_mould.eats: The slime is eating your gear.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.calls: Hold still, child. The light is not done with you.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.done: Breathe. There. It is paid, and I must rest.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.tends: Salt and rue for the dead, so they wait whole.
speech.jaymoskingdoms.druid.begins: The wood will lend a new body. Lie still, and be given.
